description.value: Rocky Point Swimming Pool is a seasonal outdoor public pool operated by the City of Port Moody, located within Rocky Point Park. The facility offers public swims, swim lessons, and Aquafit classes during the summer season. Rocky Point Park sits along the Burrard Inlet shoreline, making it a scenic stop for cyclists exploring the Tri-Cities area.
